description: An audit log entry describing an action performed in your organization or project.

project_id.description: ID of the project the audited action occurred in.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization the audited action occurred in.

service.description: The originating Mixpanel service for this audit log entry.

event_category.description: High-level category describing the type of audited event.

organization_name.description: Name of the organization at the time the audited action occurred.

ttl_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp at which the audit log entry expires and may be deleted.

client_ip.description: IP address of the client that initiated the audited action.

http_method.description: HTTP method of the request that triggered the audited action (e.g. GET, POST).

http_request_headers.description: HTTP request headers from the request that triggered the audited action.

http_request_size.description: Size of the HTTP request body in bytes.

http_response_headers.description: HTTP response headers returned for the request that triggered the audited action.

http_response_size.description: Size of the HTTP response body in bytes.

http_status.description: HTTP status code returned for the request that triggered the audited action.

http_url.description: URL of the request that triggered the audited action.

http_user_agent.description: User-Agent header from the request that triggered the audited action.

project_name.description: Name of the project at the time the audited action occurred.

user_email.description: Email of the user who performed the audited action.

user_id.description: ID of the user who performed the audited action.

user_roles.description: Comma-separated list of roles held by the user at the time of the audited action.

created.description: UTC timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

was_impersonated_by_staff.description: Whether the action was performed by a Mixpanel staff member acting on behalf of your organization.

entity.description: The entity that was acted upon, including its type, action, and action-specific payload.

entity_id.description: Unique identifier for the entity targeted by the audit log entry.

entity_name.description: Name of the entity targeted by the audit log entry.

payload.description: The payload of the audit log entry, which contains the details of the action performed.

action.description: Action performed on the entity targeted by the audit log entry.

entity_type.description: Type of the entity targeted by the audit log entry.

type.description: The type of the audit log entry, which is a combination of the entity type and action.
